evidence: Flooring is implemented in the Predictor base class, not benchmark.py: predictors/predictor.py:129 sets clip_min default 0.0; predict_batch applies it (predictors/predictor.py:145-148) via _clip (predictors/predictor.py:160-169), which maps every point and every quantile band value through max(lo, v) with lo=0.0. Docstring predictors/predictor.py:112-121 states every forecast target is a non-negative rate and clipping lives once in the base class so it applies to every backend. Matches thesis prose (tex/predictors.tex:74).
